zb derivation show --dot --output=graph.dot hello.lua
grep 'hello\.txt' graph.dot
grep 'hello2\.txt\.drv.*->.*hello\.txt' graph.dot
grep 'hello4\.txt\.drv.*->.*hello2\.txt.drv' graph.dot

# Check Graphviz syntax.
? cat graph.dot
[exec:nop] exec nop -p graph.dot

-- hello.lua --
local catcatMetatable = { __name = "catcat" }

function catcat(name, input)
  return setmetatable({
    name = name;
    input = input;
  }, catcatMetatable)
end

function catcatMetatable:__outputs(system)
  local drvArgs = {
    name = self.name;
    system = system;
    ["in"] = defaultOutput(self.input, system);
  }
  if system:match("-windows$") then
    drvArgs.builder = [[C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe]]
    drvArgs.args = {
      "-Command",
      [[Write-Output "catcat" ; $x = Get-Content -Raw ${env:in} ; ($x + $x) | Out-File -NoNewline -Encoding ascii -FilePath ${env:out}]],
    }
  else
    drvArgs.builder = "/bin/sh"
    drvArgs.args = {
      "-c",
      [[echo catcat >&2 ; while read line; do echo "$line"; done < $in > $out; while read line; do echo "$line"; done < $in >> $out]],
    }
  end
  return derivation(drvArgs).out
end

local input = path("hello.txt")
return catcat("hello4.txt", catcat("hello2.txt", input))

-- hello.txt --
Hello, World!
